==================================================
DATABASE SCHEMA
==================================================

📄 TABLE: FantasyOwners_LLM
   Description: The master list of all fantasy league managers (owners). Use this to find an owner's ID from their name and vice versa. 
   Columns:
  - owner_id: The unique primary key for a fantasy owner. Use this ID to join from this table to others like FantasyTeams_LLM.
  - owner_name: The display name of the fantasy owner. Use this for filtering when a user asks about a specific person (e.g., 'Dylan').
  - total_wins: The owner's total number of wins across all regular seasons they have participated in.
  - total_losses: The owner's total number of losses across all regular seasons they have participated in.
  - total_ties: The owner's total number of ties across all regular seasons they have participated in.
  - total_win_percentage: The owner's lifetime winning percentage for regular season games.
  - total_points_for: The total number of fantasy points this owner's teams have scored across all regular seasons.
  - total_points_against: The total number of fantasy points scored against this owner's teams across all regular seasons.
  - points_for_per_game: The average number of points this owner's teams score per regular season game over their lifetime.
  - points_against_per_game: The average number of points scored against this owner's teams per regular season game over their lifetime.
  - total_player_acquisitions: The total number of players this owner has acquired across all seasons.
  - average_final_standing: The owner's average final ranking (including playoffs) at the end of all seasons they participated in.
  - championships_won: The total number of fantasy league championships this owner has won.
  - average_regular_season_finish: The owner's average finishing position at the end of the regular season across all seasons.

📄 TABLE: FantasySeasons_LLM
   Description: Contains high-level metadata about each season (year). Use this to find the champion of a specific year or to get a season_id from a year.
   Columns:
  - season_id: The unique primary key for a fantasy season, representing the calendar year (e.g., 2022, 2023). Use this ID to join to other tables to filter data for a specific year.
  - league_name: The name of the fantasy league for that particular season.
  - team_count: The total number of teams that participated in the league during that season.
  - playoff_team_count: The number of teams that qualified for the playoffs in that season.
  - regular_season_matchup_count: The number of matchups each team played during the regular season.
  - scoring_format: The scoring format used for the league in that season (e.g., 'PPR', 'Standard').
  - champion_owner_id: The owner_id of the champion. JOIN to FantasyOwners_LLM on this ID to get the champion's name.
  - champion_team_id: The fantasy_team_id of the champion. JOIN to FantasyTeams_LLM on this ID to get the champion's team name.

📄 TABLE: FantasyTeams_LLM
   Description: Contains one row for each team in a specific season. This is the critical link between an owner, a team, and a season. Contains the final standing for the team for the specific year. Use this table when answering questions about finish positions or final standings.
   Columns:
  - fantasy_team_id: The unique primary key for a specific fantasy team within a specific season. An owner can have different team IDs across different seasons.
  - season_id: Foreign key to `FantasySeasons_LLM`. Use this to find a team's data for a specific season/year.
  - owner_id: Foreign key to `FantasyOwners_LLM`. Use this to find all teams belonging to a specific owner.
  - fantasy_team_name: The name of the fantasy team for that season.
  - final_standing: The team's final rank in the league at the end of the season, including playoffs.
  - logo_url: A URL to the fantasy team's logo image.
  - wins: The number of wins for this team in this season's regular season.
  - losses: The number of losses for this team in this season's regular season.
  - ties: The number of ties for this team in this season's regular season.
  - points_for: The total points scored by this team during this season's regular season.
  - points_against: The total points scored against this team during this season's regular season.
  - total_player_acquisitions: The number of players this team acquired during this season.
  - total_player_drops: The number of players this team dropped during this season.
  - trades: The number of trades this team made during this season.

📄 TABLE: FantasyDraftPicks_LLM
   Description: Contains every single pick from every fantasy draft. Use for questions about draft position, who drafted a player, etc.
   Columns:
  - draft_id: The unique primary key for a single draft pick.
  - season_id: Foreign key to `FantasySeasons_LLM` to identify the year of the draft.
  - owner_id: Foreign key to `FantasyOwners_LLM` to identify the owner who made the pick.
  - fantasy_team_id: Foreign key to `FantasyTeams_LLM` to identify the team that made the pick.
  - player_id: Foreign key to `Players_LLM` to identify the player who was drafted.
  - round: The round number in which the player was drafted.
  - pick_in_round: The pick number within that specific round.
  - overall_pick_number: The overall pick number in the entire draft.
  - player_position: The position of the player at the time they were drafted.
  - rank_at_position_in_draft: The rank of the player at their position when they were drafted.

📄 TABLE: FantasyMatchups_LLM
   Description: Contains every head-to-head game played. This is the primary source for weekly scores, wins, and losses between teams. Use this for questions about a specific week or matchup. Includes information about playoff, regular season, and championship matches.
   Columns:
  - matchup_id: The unique primary key for a single matchup.
  - season_id: Foreign key to `FantasySeasons_LLM`. Use this to filter matchups by a specific year.
  - nfl_week: The week of the NFL season that this fantasy matchup corresponds to.
  - fantasy_week: The fantasy week name or number (e.g., 'Week 1').
  - home_owner_id: Foreign key to `FantasyOwners_LLM` for the owner of the home team.
  - away_owner_id: Foreign key to `FantasyOwners_LLM` for the owner of the away team.
  - home_fantasy_team_id: Foreign key to `FantasyTeams_LLM` for the home team.
  - away_fantasy_team_id: Foreign key to `FantasyTeams_LLM` for the away team.
  - home_score: The final fantasy point total for the home team.
  - away_score: The final fantasy point total for the away team.
  - winning_owner_id: The owner_id of the owner who won the matchup. Will be NULL if there was a tie.
  - losing_owner_id: The owner_id of the owner who lost the matchup. Will be NULL if there was a tie.
  - tie: A boolean value (1 for true, 0 for false) indicating if the matchup was a tie.
  - matchup_category: Category for the type matchup. Values are 'Regular Season', 'Postseason (Non-playoff)', or 'Playoff' . Use this to filter for regular season games.
  - is_a_playoff_matchup: A boolean value (1 for true, 0 for false) indicating if the matchup was a playoff matchup. Use this to filter for playoff games.
  - playoff_matchup_category: Category for the playoff matchup. Values are 'Quarterfinal', 'Semifinal', 'Championship', or NULL for non-playoff matchups. Use this filter the results of championships, quarterfinals, and semifinal matchups.

📄 TABLE: Players_LLM
   Description: The master list of all individual NFL players in the database. Use this table to find a player's ID from their name.
   Columns:
  - player_id: The unique primary key for an individual player. Use this to join to all player stats tables.
  - player_name: The full name of the player. Use this for filtering when a user asks about a specific player.

📄 TABLE: NFLTeams_LLM
   Description: The master list of all 32 NFL teams. Use this to map an nfl_team_id to its full name (e.g., 'GB' to 'Green Bay Packers').
   Columns:
  - nfl_team_id: The unique primary key for an NFL team (e.g., 'GB', 'KC'). Use this to join to player stats tables to get the team's full name.
  - nfl_team_name: The full name of the NFL team (e.g., 'Green Bay Packers').

📄 TABLE: PlayerStats_Season_QB_LLM
   Description: Contains seasonal (full-season) statistics for Quarterback (QB) players. Use for questions about a QB's performance over an entire season.
   Columns:
  - player_season_stats_id: Unique primary key for this specific seasonal stat line.
  - season_id: Foreign key to `FantasySeasons_LLM` to filter by year.
  - player_id: Foreign key to `Players_LLM` to link stats to a player's name.
  - nfl_team_id: Foreign key to `NFLTeams_LLM` for the player's NFL team that season.
  - games_played: The number of games the player played in that season.
  - passes_attempted: Total number of pass attempts by the QB for the season.
  - passes_completed: Total number of completed passes by the QB for the season.
  - passing_completion_percentage: The QB's pass completion percentage for the season.
  - total_passing_yards: Total passing yards for the season.
  - passing_yards_per_attempt: The QB's average passing yards per pass attempt for the season.
  - passing_touchdowns: Total passing touchdowns for the season.
  - interceptions: Total interceptions thrown for the season.
  - passer_rating: The QB's passer rating for the season.
  - rushing_attempts: Total rushing attempts by the QB for the season.
  - total_rushing_yards: Total rushing yards by the QB for the season.
  - rushing_touchdowns: Total rushing touchdowns by the QB for the season.
  - season_rank: The player's final rank among all players at their position for the season.
  - fantasy_points_per_game: The player's average fantasy points per game for the season.
  - total_fantasy_points: The player's total fantasy points for the entire season.

📄 TABLE: DraftAnalysis_Full_LLM
   Description: A comprehensive analysis view combining draft data with player performance. Use this for advanced questions about draft value, steals, and busts.
   Columns:
  - season_id: The season (year) of the draft.
  - pick_overall: The overall pick number in the entire draft.
  - draft_id: The unique ID for the draft entry.
  - round: The round number in which the player was drafted.
  - pick_in_round: The pick number within that specific round.
  - player_id: The unique ID of the drafted player.
  - player_name: The name of the drafted player.
  - player_position: The position of the player at the time of the draft.
  - nfl_team_id: The ID of the player's NFL team.
  - nfl_team_name: The name of the player's NFL team.
  - fantasy_team_id: The ID of the fantasy team that made the pick.
  - fantasy_team_name: The name of the fantasy team that made the pick.
  - owner_id: The ID of the owner who made the pick.
  - owner_name: The name of the owner who made the pick.
  - league_positional_draft_rank: The rank of the player at their position when they were drafted 
  - overall_adp_rank: Average Draft Position (ADP). The player's average draft position across a wider market of fantasy drafts.
  - positional_adp_rank: The player's market-wide average draft position relative to other players at the same position.
  - draft_value_vs_adp: A calculated value indicating how much of a 'reach' or 'steal' the pick was compared to the market ADP. A negative value is a reach, a positive value is a steal.
  - actual_total_fantasy_points_season: The total fantasy points the player actually scored during that entire season.
  - fantasy_points_per_game: The average fantasy points per game the player actually scored during that season.
  - actual_positional_finish_rank: The player's final rank among all players at their position for that season.
  - expected_points: The pre-calculated number of fantasy points a player was expected to score based on their draft position.
  - points_scored_over_expected: The difference between the player's actual total fantasy points and their expected points. A positive value means they overperformed expectations.
  - player_finish_position_vs_drafted_position: The difference between the player's draft rank and their final finish rank at their position. A positive value means they outperformed their draft position (e.g., drafted 10th, finished 5th = +5).

📄 TABLE: HeadToHeadMatchups_LLM

   Columns:
  - matchup_id: The unique primary key for a single head-to-head game.
  - season_id: The season (year) the matchup took place. Use this to join to other season-specific tables.
  - league_name: The name of the fantasy league for that season.
  - scoring_format: The scoring format used for the league in that season (e.g., 'Standard', 'PPR').
  - nfl_week: The corresponding week of the real-world NFL season.
  - fantasy_week: The name or number of the fantasy week within the league's schedule (e.g., 'Week 1').
  - matchup_category: A high-level category for the matchup. Values are 'Regular Season', 'Postseason (Non-playoff)',or 'Playoff'.
  - playoff_matchup_category: Specifies the type of playoff game, such as 'Quarterfinal', 'Semifinal', or 'Championship'. This column is only populated for playoff matchups and will be NULL for regular season games.
  - owner1_id: The unique ID of owner 1, who is designated as the HOME team for this matchup.
  - owner1_name: The name of owner 1 (the HOME team).
  - owner1_team_id: The unique ID of owner 1's fantasy team for this matchup.
  - owner1_team_name: The name of owner 1's fantasy team.
  - owner1_score: The final fantasy point total for owner 1 (the HOME team).
  - owner2_id: The unique ID of owner 2, who is designated as the AWAY team for this matchup.
  - owner2_name: The name of owner 2 (the AWAY team).
  - owner2_team_id: The unique ID of owner 2's fantasy team for this matchup.
  - owner2_team_name: The name of owner 2's fantasy team.
  - owner2_score: The final fantasy point total for owner 2 (the AWAY team).
  - winning_owner_id: The ID of the owner who won the matchup. This will be NULL if the game was a tie.

📄 TABLE: RegularSeasonStandings_LLM
   Description: Provides the final regular season standings for each team in each season. This view EXCLUDES playoff games and is the definitive source for regular season records and points.
   Columns:
  - season_id: The season (year) of the standings.
  - fantasy_team_id: The unique ID of the fantasy team for that season.
  - owner_id: The unique ID of the team's owner.

  - fantasy_team_name: The name of the fantasy team.
  - regular_season_wins: Number of wins during the regular season only. Excludes playoff games.
  - regular_season_losses: Number of losses during the regular season only. Excludes playoff games.
  - regular_season_ties: Number of ties during the regular season only. Excludes playoff games.
  - regular_season_points_for: Total points scored by the team during the regular season only.
  - regular_season_points_against: Total points scored against the team during the regular season only.
  - regular_season_finish_position: The team's final rank for the regular season, calculated by wins then points for. A rank of 1 is the best.

📄 TABLE: OwnerCareerLeaderboard_LLM
   Description: A summary view that aggregates career statistics for each fantasy owner. Each row represents one owner's entire league history. This is the best table for questions about all-time records and rankings.
   Columns:

  - owner_name: The display name of the fantasy owner.
  - career_wins: The owner's total number of wins across all seasons they have participated in, including both regular season and playoff games.
  - career_losses: The owner's total number of losses across all seasons they have participated in, including both regular season and playoff games.
  - career_ties: The owner's total number of ties across all seasons they have participated in.
  - championships_won: The total number of fantasy league championships this owner has won over their career.
  - career_points_for: The total fantasy points the owner's teams have scored across their entire career.
  - career_points_against: The total fantasy points scored against the owner's teams across their entire career.
  - career_win_percentage: The owner's career winning percentage, calculated from their total wins, losses, and ties across all games.
  - career_playoff_rate: The percentage of seasons the owner participated in where their team qualified for the playoffs (e.g., a value of 0.44 means they made the playoffs in 44% of their seasons).
  - player_acquisitions: The total number of players this owner has acquired (e.g., via free agency or waivers) over their entire career.
  - avg_regular_season_finish: The owner's average finishing position at the end of the regular season, averaged across all seasons they participated in. A lower number is better.
  - avg_final_standing: The owner's average final ranking at the end of all seasons (including playoffs), averaged across all seasons. A lower number is better.

  - opponent: The nfl_team_id of the opponent team. Join to `NFLTeams_LLM` to get the full name.
  - field_goals_made: Field goals successfully made by the Kicker for the week.
  - extra_points_made: Extra points successfully made by the Kicker for the week.
  - total_fantasy_points: The player's total fantasy points for this specific week.

📄 TABLE: PlayerStats_Weekly_DST_LLM
   Description: Contains weekly, game-by-game statistics for Defense/Special Teams (DST). Use for questions about a DST's performance in a single game or week.
   Columns:
  - player_weekly_stats_id: Unique primary key for this specific weekly stat line.
  - season_id: Foreign key to `FantasySeasons_LLM` to filter by year.
  - player_id: Foreign key for the 'player', which for a DST is the team. NOTE: For DST, this ID corresponds to the nfl_team_id from the NFLTeams_LLM table.
  - nfl_team_id: Foreign key for the NFL team. Links to `NFLTeams_LLM`.
  - game_week: The week of the NFL season for this stat line.
  - opponent: The nfl_team_id of the opponent team. Join to `NFLTeams_LLM` to get the full name.
  - defensive_sacks: Sacks made by the defense for the week.
  - defensive_interceptions: Interceptions made by the defense for the week.
  - fumbles_recovered: Fumbles recovered by the defense for the week.
  - safeties: Safeties scored by the defense for the week.
  - defensive_touchdowns: Touchdowns scored by the defense itself (e.g., pick-six).
  - return_touchdowns: Touchdowns scored by the special teams on returns.
  - opponents_points_scored: Points allowed to the opposing offense in this game.
  - total_fantasy_points: The team's total fantasy points for this specific week.

📄 TABLE: DraftAnalysis_Full_LLM
   Description: A comprehensive analysis view combining draft data with player performance. Use this for advanced questions about draft value, steals, and busts.
   Columns:
  - season_id: The season (year) of the draft.
  - pick_overall: The overall pick number in the entire draft.
  - draft_id: The unique ID for the draft entry.
  - round: The round number in which the player was drafted.
  - pick_in_round: The pick number within that specific round.
  - player_id: The unique ID of the drafted player.
  - player_name: The name of the drafted player.
  - player_position: The position of the player at the time of the draft.
  - nfl_team_id: The ID of the player's NFL team.
  - nfl_team_name: The name of the player's NFL team.
  - fantasy_team_id: The ID of the fantasy team that made the pick.
  - fantasy_team_name: The name of the fantasy team that made the pick.
  - owner_id: The ID of the owner who made the pick.
  - owner_name: The name of the owner who made the pick.
  - league_positional_draft_rank: The rank of the player at their position when they were drafted 
  - overall_adp_rank: Average Draft Position (ADP). The player's average draft position across a wider market of fantasy drafts.
  - positional_adp_rank: The player's market-wide average draft position relative to other players at the same position.
  - draft_value_vs_adp: A calculated value indicating how much of a 'reach' or 'steal' the pick was compared to the market ADP. A negative value is a reach, a positive value is a steal.
  - actual_total_fantasy_points_season: The total fantasy points the player actually scored during that entire season.
  - fantasy_points_per_game: The average fantasy points per game the player actually scored during that season.
  - actual_positional_finish_rank: The player's final rank among all players at their position for that season.
  - expected_points: The pre-calculated number of fantasy points a player was expected to score based on their draft position.
  - points_scored_over_expected: The difference between the player's actual total fantasy points and their expected points. A positive value means they overperformed expectations.
  - player_finish_position_vs_drafted_position: The difference between the player's draft rank and their final finish rank at their position. A positive value means they outperformed their draft position (e.g., drafted 10th, finished 5th = +5).

📄 TABLE: HeadToHeadMatchups_LLM
   Description: Provides a detailed, side-by-side view of every head-to-head matchup, including team names, owner names, and scores for both sides. Best for direct win/loss questions between two specific owners.
   Columns:
  - matchup_id: The unique primary key for a single head-to-head game.
  - season_id: The season (year) the matchup took place. Use this to join to other season-specific tables.
  - league_name: The name of the fantasy league for that season.
  - scoring_format: The scoring format used for the league in that season (e.g., 'Standard', 'PPR').
  - nfl_week: The corresponding week of the real-world NFL season.
  - fantasy_week: The name or number of the fantasy week within the league's schedule (e.g., 'Week 1').
  - matchup_category: A high-level category for the matchup. Values are 'Regular Season', 'Postseason (Non-playoff)',or 'Playoff'.
  - playoff_matchup_category: Specifies the type of playoff game, such as 'Quarterfinal', 'Semifinal', or 'Championship'. This column is only populated for playoff matchups and will be NULL for regular season games.
  - owner1_id: The unique ID of owner 1, who is designated as the HOME team for this matchup.
  - owner1_name: The name of owner 1 (the HOME team).
  - owner1_team_id: The unique ID of owner 1's fantasy team for this matchup.
  - owner1_team_name: The name of owner 1's fantasy team.
  - owner1_score: The final fantasy point total for owner 1 (the HOME team).
  - owner2_id: The unique ID of owner 2, who is designated as the AWAY team for this matchup.
  - owner2_name: The name of owner 2 (the AWAY team).
  - owner2_team_id: The unique ID of owner 2's fantasy team for this matchup.
  - owner2_team_name: The name of owner 2's fantasy team.
  - owner2_score: The final fantasy point total for owner 2 (the AWAY team).
  - winning_owner_id: The ID of the owner who won the matchup. This will be NULL if the game was a tie.
  - losing_owner_id: The ID of the owner who lost the matchup. This will be NULL if the game was a tie.
  - tie: A boolean value (1 for true, 0 for false) indicating if the matchup ended in a tie.
  - margin_of_victory: The absolute point difference between the two scores, representing the margin of victory.

📄 TABLE: RegularSeasonStandings_LLM
   Description: Provides the final regular season standings for each team in each season. This view EXCLUDES playoff games and is the definitive source for regular season records and points.
   Columns:
  - season_id: The season (year) of the standings.
  - fantasy_team_id: The unique ID of the fantasy team for that season.
  - owner_id: The unique ID of the team's owner.
  - owner_name: The name of the team's owner.
  - fantasy_team_name: The name of the fantasy team.
  - regular_season_wins: Number of wins during the regular season only. Excludes playoff games.
  - regular_season_losses: Number of losses during the regular season only. Excludes playoff games.
  - regular_season_ties: Number of ties during the regular season only. Excludes playoff games.
  - regular_season_points_for: Total points scored by the team during the regular season only.
  - regular_season_points_against: Total points scored against the team during the regular season only.
  - regular_season_finish_position: The team's final rank for the regular season, calculated by wins then points for. A rank of 1 is the best.

📄 TABLE: OwnerCareerLeaderboard_LLM
   Description: A summary view that aggregates career statistics for each fantasy owner. Each row represents one owner's entire league history. This is the best table for questions about all-time records and rankings.
   Columns:
  - owner_id: The unique primary key for the fantasy owner. Use this ID to join to other tables.
  - owner_name: The display name of the fantasy owner.
  - career_wins: The owner's total number of wins across all seasons they have participated in, including both regular season and playoff games.
  - career_losses: The owner's total number of losses across all seasons they have participated in, including both regular season and playoff games.
  - career_ties: The owner's total number of ties across all seasons they have participated in.
  - championships_won: The total number of fantasy league championships this owner has won over their career.
  - career_points_for: The total fantasy points the owner's teams have scored across their entire career.
  - career_points_against: The total fantasy points scored against the owner's teams across their entire career.
  - career_win_percentage: The owner's career winning percentage, calculated from their total wins, losses, and ties across all games.
  - career_playoff_rate: The percentage of seasons the owner participated in where their team qualified for the playoffs (e.g., a value of 0.44 means they made the playoffs in 44% of their seasons).
  - player_acquisitions: The total number of players this owner has acquired (e.g., via free agency or waivers) over their entire career.
  - avg_regular_season_finish: The owner's average finishing position at the end of the regular season, averaged across all seasons they participated in. A lower number is better.
  - avg_final_standing: The owner's average final ranking at the end of all seasons (including playoffs), averaged across all seasons. A lower number is better.
